description: This file implements RADIUS server functionality within a Wi-Fi access point, including TLS event handling, user data management, configuration loading, and server initialization for authentication purposes.

methods.name: radius_tls_event
methods.description: Handles TLS events such as certificate verification, alerts, and peer certificate info, logging relevant messages.

methods.name: radius_userdata_init
methods.description: Initializes radius user data structures, including key-value list and AVL tree.

methods.name: radius_userdata_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with radius user data, including key-value list and AVL tree elements.

methods.name: radius_userdata_load
methods.description: Loads user data into radius user data structures from JSON blob attributes.

methods.name: load_userfile
methods.description: Loads and updates user data from a specified user file, checking for modifications.

methods.name: radius_user_get
methods.description: Retrieves user data blob by username, supporting wildcard pattern matching.

methods.name: radius_parse_attr
methods.description: Parses radius attribute data from blob attributes, determining format and size.

methods.name: radius_count_attrs
methods.description: Counts the number of attributes and total size needed for radius attributes based on user data.

methods.name: radius_add_attr
methods.description: Adds a radius attribute to the attribute list, handling vendor-specific attributes.

methods.name: radius_parse_attrs
methods.description: Parses and adds radius attributes from user data blobs.

methods.name: radius_user_parse_methods
methods.description: Parses EAP methods from user data and updates the user structure accordingly.

methods.name: radius_user_get_state
methods.description: Retrieves or creates user state for a given username, parsing and storing user attributes.

methods.name: radius_get_eap_user
methods.description: Callback to retrieve EAP user data based on identity, supporting phase 1 and phase 2.

methods.name: radius_setup
methods.description: Initializes the radius server and TLS configuration based on provided settings.

methods.name: radius_init
methods.description: Initializes radius server state and user data structures.

methods.name: radius_deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes radius server and cleans up resources.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the radius main program.

methods.name: radius_main
methods.description: Main entry point for the radius server program, parsing command-line options, initializing, and running event loop.
